messages:
maya_support: Hey team — customer ACME Inc (acct: acme-273) reporting trial grant stuck: signup returns 'payment_required' and UI shows 'Card required' even after card added. 3DS flow shows challenge opened then user closed it. Any known webhook issues?
sam_billing: I saw a few of these today. Which payment gateway? Stripe or Adyen?
maya_support: Stripe. PaymentIntent status: requires_action -> requires_payment_method after challenge. Logs: gateway returned 402_card_declined: authentication_required. Customer says they completed auth, redirected back, then error.
henry_sre: Got the request id? If the webhook for payment_intent.succeeded didn't reach us the trial grant job may have retried and created a hold. Can you paste the webhook payload (redact PI keys)?
maya_support: pasting sanitized payload:
```json
{ "id": "evt_1KxxXx", "type": "payment_intent.succeeded", "data": { "object": { "id": "pi_1JyyYy", "status": "succeeded", "metadata": { "account_id": "acme-273", "trial_flow": "card_on_file" } } } }
```
payment-bot: [webhook-retry] failed delivery attempt 3 -> 504 gateway timeout for evt_1KxxXx. Queueing retry.
sam_billing: If webhook failed, our worker will retry but Stripe may mark card as 'requires_action' after auth cancellation. The UI might still think card is attached but the PaymentIntent is not confirmed. Check PaymentMethod attached to customer.
maya_support: Checked: customer has pm_1Abc attached, but payments show 'last_payment_error': {"type":"card_error","code":"authentication_required"}. Cycles look like: user starts 3DS -> issuer returns redirect back -> Stripe marks requires_payment_method.
henry_sre: Root cause could be race between webhook processing and our trial grant lambda. Sequence: 1) customer completes 3DS -> Stripe emits payment_intent.succeeded 2) our webhook delivery times out -> we don't confirm grant 3) user retries UI -> our front-end polls and sees payment_method on customer but PaymentIntent didn't finalize -> we end in 'card required' UI. Workaround: manually grant trial from billing console.
oliver_sales: Customer is on a demo deadline — can we issue 7-day trial manually and follow up? I can ask for written confirmation.
maya_support: Yes please. Sam — can you create workaround steps and GA ticket for gateway-timeout handling? Also need a one-off script to reconcile pending events older than 24h.
sam_billing: Creating internal ticket: BILL-4287. Workaround steps:
1) In Billing Console -> search acme-273 -> click 'Grant trial' -> confirm.
2) Run reconcile: `scripts/reconcile_webhooks --since 2025-07-01 --filter account=acme-273`
3) If PaymentIntent shows succeeded on Stripe but our DB didn't, call `POST /internal/payments/confirm` with pid.
I'll attach a safe script.
henry_sre: I'll add idempotent webhook handler to ensure retries don't double-create holds. Also add a 10s backoff and check Stripe event delivery sig.
payment-bot: Automated note: webhook delivery restored for evt_1KxxXx on attempt 4.
maya_support: :thumbsup: Manual trial granted and customer confirmed. Will follow up with postmortem and guidance for users to stay on 3DS screen until final redirect. Marking resolved.
